profile.headline: Software Engineer at Mastercard | M.S. in Computer Science
profile.summary: Adaptable and resourceful Backend Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience in object-oriented programming. Recent Master’s graduate seeking opportunities in backend software development or cloud computing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented ZeroMQ in a C++ application, decreasing latency by 30% and ensuring reliable delivery
- Designed a control panel GUI with Python and Tkinter to send automated flight inputs to a Pixhawk controller, allowing engineers to perform flight tests in a controlled and repeatable manner
- Migrated software to Docker to allow users to run software regardless of host OS or dependencies
- Developed a central ground application for a flight simulation in Python to monitor and send commands to autonomy/AI on up to 4 LVC (Live, Virtual, Constructive) capabilities
- Reverse-engineered third party software to evaluate architecture and design and provide feedback
- Defined speech patterns using XML and Microsoft Speech API (SAPI) to implement voice command for pilots

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
EN.605.202 Data Structures
- Mentored 10+ students and maintained expertise in subject area to assist students with course content
- Evaluated student assignments and provided descriptive feedback within a week of submission

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Improved search engine optimization (SEO) for articles by adding relevant meta-tags to HTML
- Extracted metadata from AWS using Python Boto3 and designed a web application in JavaScript/HTML so the team could view the state of AWS services without having direct access to the console
- Created an interactive SVG diagram with D3.js to visualize the nested structure of AWS services

positions.title: IT Support Dispatcher
positions.description:
- Served as the primary point of contact for assistance with technology throughout campus
- Provided remote troubleshooting and recorded details for future reference
- Managed a team of technicians to be dispatched to client if they required in-person support with classroom technologies

positions.title: 3D Scanning Technician
positions.description:
- Scanned plaster tooth models using 3shape CAD scanning
- Altered and designed implants, inlays/onlays, and veneers

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
- Processed customer invoices
- Answered telephone and relayed information to callers, took messages, and transferred calls
- Maintained cleanliness in kennels and cared for patients
